title.en: Field research & academic exchange in Bhutan
title.zh: 不丹实地研究与学术交流

summary.en: Farmer interviews, mountain fieldwork, and a visit to the Royal University of Bhutan, connecting local knowledge with wheat genetic resources research.
summary.zh: 通过农户访谈、山地田间实践与不丹皇家大学访问，将地方生产经验与小麦遗传资源研究相连接。

body.en: During a 2026 visit to Bhutan, I combined wheat genetic resources fieldwork with farmer interviews and academic exchange. The visit included the Royal University of Bhutan (RUB) and its College of Natural Resources (CNR), where I also carried out practical teaching in wheat DNA extraction.
body.zh: 2026 年的不丹访问结合了小麦遗传资源实地研究、农户访谈与学术交流。访问机构包括不丹皇家大学（RUB）及其自然资源学院（CNR）；在 CNR，我还开展了小麦 DNA 提取实践教学。

alt.en: Research team and a farmer in conversation around a table, with a notebook and laptop.
alt.zh: 研究团队与农户围坐交流，使用笔记本与电脑记录访谈。

caption.en: A farmer interview during the Bhutan visit: discussing local production practices and knowledge associated with crop genetic resources.
caption.zh: 不丹访问期间的农户访谈：围绕当地生产实践与作物种质相关知识开展交流。

title.en: Listening to farmers, connecting to the field

paragraphs.en: Farmer interviews provided an opportunity to document local production practices and germplasm-related knowledge. Alongside these conversations, I worked on the planning and establishment of multi-elevation field trials, connecting field observations with accession histories and genomic analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 通过农户访谈记录当地生产实践与种质相关知识。同时参与多海拔田间试验的地点规划、试验布局与材料种植，将田间观察与种质来源记录、基因组分析相连接。

paragraphs.en: The visit to the Royal University of Bhutan formed part of the academic exchange during this trip. Alongside the RUB visit, I carried out practical teaching at its College of Natural Resources, bringing together institutional exchange and hands-on laboratory work.
paragraphs.zh: 此次行程中访问了不丹皇家大学，并在其自然资源学院开展实践教学，将机构交流与实验操作相结合。下方合影记录了 RUB 访问期间的交流。

alt.en: Four visitors and hosts posing indoors during a visit to the Royal University of Bhutan.
alt.zh: 不丹皇家大学（RUB）访问期间的室内合影。

caption.en: A group photograph during the visit to the Royal University of Bhutan (RUB).
caption.zh: 访问不丹皇家大学（Royal University of Bhutan，RUB）期间的合影。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the research activities, these photographs record the mountain scenery, rivers, and traditional architecture encountered during the visit.
paragraphs.zh: 研究与交流之外，这些照片记录了访问途中所见的山地、河流与传统建筑。

alt.en: Colourful prayer flags in front of cloud-covered mountains and a green valley in Bhutan.
alt.zh: 不丹山谷中的彩色经幡，远处是云层下的山地与植被。

caption.en: Mountain landscapes and prayer flags seen during the Bhutan visit.
caption.zh: 不丹访问途中所见的山地景观与经幡。

alt.en: A personal travel photograph beside a river, with traditional Bhutanese architecture and mountains in the background.
alt.zh: 河畔个人留影，背景为不丹传统建筑与山地景观。

caption.en: A moment from the visit, with Bhutanese architecture, rivers, and mountain scenery.
caption.zh: 访问途中的留影：不丹传统建筑、河流与山地景观。

location.zh: 自然资源学院 · 不丹

title.en: Wheat DNA extraction practical teaching at CNR
title.zh: CNR 小麦 DNA 提取实践教学

summary.en: Practical teaching at the College of Natural Resources, Royal University of Bhutan, combining demonstration and supervised practice in wheat genomic DNA extraction.
summary.zh: 在不丹皇家大学自然资源学院，通过操作示范与实验指导开展小麦基因组 DNA 提取实践教学。

body.en: During the visit to the College of Natural Resources (CNR), Royal University of Bhutan, I carried out practical teaching in wheat genomic DNA extraction as part of the collaborative wheat genetic resources project.
body.zh: 访问不丹皇家大学自然资源学院（College of Natural Resources，CNR）期间，我结合小麦遗传资源合作项目，在学院开展了小麦基因组 DNA 提取实践教学。

alt.en: A group photograph in the courtyard of the College of Natural Resources, Royal University of Bhutan.
alt.zh: 不丹皇家大学自然资源学院（CNR）访问期间的校园合影。

caption.en: A campus group photograph at the College of Natural Resources (CNR), Royal University of Bhutan. Wheat DNA extraction practical teaching was carried out during this visit.
caption.zh: 访问不丹皇家大学自然资源学院（CNR）期间的校园合影；此次访问中在学院开展了小麦 DNA 提取实践教学。

title.zh: 从操作示范到动手实践

paragraphs.en: Teaching combined demonstrations with supervised laboratory practice, with an emphasis on sample handling and reproducible procedures.
paragraphs.zh: 教学通过操作示范与实验指导相结合的方式进行，注重样品处理和实验流程的可重复性。

title.zh: 欧洲学术访问与德国 BioHackathon

summary.en: Planned research discussions in Zurich and participation in BioHackathon Germany on image-based wheat phenotyping.
summary.zh: 计划在苏黎世开展研究交流，并参加德国 BioHackathon，围绕小麦图像表型开展合作。

body.en: Planned visits include ETH Zurich and the University of Zurich, followed by BioHackathon Germany in Göttingen (7–11 December). Topics include wheat diversity, adaptation, image-based phenotyping, and wheat spike detection. This activity is planned, not yet completed.
body.zh: 计划访问苏黎世联邦理工学院与苏黎世大学，随后参加哥廷根的德国 BioHackathon（12 月 7–11 日）。交流主题包括小麦多样性、适应性、图像表型与麦穗检测。本活动尚未完成。
